text:
deploybot: Planned rollout: v2 -> edges. Start=2026-04-01T10:00:00Z. Initial 5% global, canary region: na-central. Pins: tenant-3, tenant-88. Notes: https://rwd.in/notes/v2-canary :book:
sara: ack. I'll take notes sign-off and push customer comms if green.
pete: infra warmup done. kv-cache primed. autoscale policy = v1 parity.
sre-bot: preflight ok. watch windows: 10m strict, 30m relaxed. Alerts set for 5xx>0.4% and p95>140ms.
ops-kim: oncall for window, will do tenant notify after shift.
deploybot: queued: `/deploy start --target v2 --pct 5 --region na-central --pins tenant-3,tenant-88 --notes https://rwd.in/notes/v2-canary`

3m later
deploybot: executing shift -> 5% to v2 in na-central. route-sync ok.
sre-bot: alert: transient 5xx spike 0.6% for 2m in na-central. link: https://rwd.in/alerts/ALRT-2500
pete: checking edge->modelpool connections; seeing increased connection resets from proxy shard alpha.
sara: pause rollout? threshold defined as >0.5% for 3m, we hit 0.6% but only 2m. recommend hold and observe 5 more minutes.
ops-kim: holding. deploybot: pause increases (no rollback)
deploybot: acknowledged. hold state saved.
5m later
sre-bot: 5xx sustained at 0.7% for 4m. Recommend partial rollback for na-central.
pete: confirming a header normalization mismatch in v2 caused proxy client to drop keepalives. reproducing in staging.
sara: initiate partial rollback na-central -> v1. ops-kim, notify tenants.
ops-kim: tenant-notify sent. pinned tenants unaffected.
deploybot: running rollback: `/deploy rollback --region na-central --target v1 --reason "5xx spike during v2 canary"`

10m later
deploybot: rollback complete for na-central. 5xx back to baseline (0.03%). Global v2 exposure now 3%.
sre-bot: marking canary failed for na-central, rollout paused. state_id=hold-1788888000.
pete: will post fix and staging repro in ticket. suggest we block full rollout until patch + staging pass.
sara: agreed. I'll update release notes to mention header normalization and recommend client SDK bump. closing loop when staging green. :white_check_mark:
